verdict.rationale: Cline's Kanban board explicitly supports running many agents in parallel with isolated git worktrees, auto-commit, and dependency chains, and its CLI supports cron-scheduled agents that persist across restarts and run independently of any terminal session, plus subagents for parallel research tasks — directly matching the fleet/parallel/long-running autonomy story. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of multi-day unattended runs and concrete reports of fleet-scale usage (community evidence is about general agent quality, not parallel fleets or multi-day persistence).
